findings.description: The inline policy grants wildcard actions (ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, cloudwatch:*) on all resources ("Resource": "*"), violating least privilege and allowing the IAM user to perform virtually any action on these services, including privilege escalation and data exfiltration.

A long-lived programmatic access key is created for an IAM user with excessive permissions, increasing the risk of credential leakage and misuse since these keys do not expire or rotate automatically and are tied to an overly broad policy.

findings.issue_category: use of IAM user instead of role
findings.description: Using a standalone IAM user with attached access keys and broad permissions instead of a role-based access model increases the attack surface for credential theft and misuse, especially combined with the excessively permissive policy attached to it.
